analysis: Documentation-only PR. Changes: docs/provider/cli-reference.md adds the --runtime-concurrency and --runtime-stagger benchmark flags (head lines 1208-1209) and a Runtime generation table row at line 564. docs/reference/configuration.md adds two env-var rows at lines 400-401 for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CHAINED and DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CARRY, documenting kill-switch-style toggles for Qwen MTP decode behavior. I examined the supplied excerpts for these against the threat model. No code, control, endpoint, default security setting or trust-boundary change is visible. The documented benchmark flags are local diagnostics: prefix cache stays off, with no coordinator, attestation or App Attest interaction, so T-041 (prefix-cache oracle), TB-002, TB-011 and T-053 are not weakened. The new env vars are stated as not forwarded to LaunchAgents, so they do not widen the daemon passthrough surface; the existing passthrough list (lines 1735-1754) is unchanged. The new env vars are performance toggles that change MTP scheduling and carry hidden-state seeding. They are not described as altering output correctness or encryption, though the source behavior behind them (MTPContractsV2.swift) was not supplied. The configuration.md unit contained only metadata with no patch text beyond the excerpt, so its full diff is unverified. Remaining question: whether the underlying code changes, if any, in this PR affect MTP acceptance or sampling correctness (T-007 and T-056 class); that is outside the supplied docs. No findings.
